title: The step lists services whose lines were added; untick to leave one
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance. Open the schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', or create it with New schedule: add service 'PM-A' with a Calendar trigger of Every 6 months and canned lines, for example 'Engine oil and filter change' 0.8 hours, 'Chassis lubrication, 12 points' 0.5 hours, 'Air filter inspection' 0.3 hours and 'Brake adjustment check' 1.2 hours (4 lines, 2.8 hours). Save. Also add service 'PM-B' (Calendar: Every 12 months) with canned lines, and a second schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Trailer PM' with service 'PM-T' (Calendar: Every 12 months) with canned lines.
  3. Enroll unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' on both schedules so PM-A, PM-B and PM-T read Overdue.
  4. On the customer page press New Work Order, choose unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' and create the work order (it opens as an estimate). Note its number, for example S3780-15904.
  5. On the work order page, find the Maintenance schedule card inside the asset card at the top and press Expand.
  6. Press Add Service > Add on PM-A, PM-B and PM-T. Then use Mark complete (the row's button) on PM-B, keeping this work order and Reset date today.
  7. On the asset's Maintenance tab remove the unit from 'ZZAUTOTEST Trailer PM' (Remove from schedule) while the work order is still open.
  8. On the Lines tab complete every line.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Finance tab and press Create Invoice. In When was the maintenance done? hover the (i) beside the title and read it.
  2. Read the list of services and the reason under each.
  3. Untick PM-A, press Confirm dates and record the payment.
  4. Open the asset's Maintenance tab and read PM-A and PM-B.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The (i) explains the step (in the design: “Each cycle counts from when that service’s lines were all closed. Untick a service to leave it as it is. Closing this accepts every date shown.”).
  • Only PM-A is listed, ticked, with its reason Lines added from PM-A.
  • PM-B is not listed: it was already reset by Mark complete (a service resets once).
  • PM-T is not listed and does not reset, because its schedule was removed from the asset while the work order was open.
  • PM-A, unticked, does not reset and stays due.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10574 (S18, Complete a service and reset the cycle); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S18; Design MR_V2_2 (Claude Design export, 6 Oct 2026), driven in full on 6 Oct 2026, Chunk 2 board artboards I1–I6; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S18-R8: “The step after invoicing lists every service whose lines were added on this work order, each ticked by default and can be unticked, with its reason, for example Lines added from PM-A. An unticked service does not reset and stays due. A service already reset by Mark complete is not listed: a service resets once”
  • S18-R18: “A service whose schedule was removed from the asset while its work order was open is not listed in the step after invoicing and does not reset”
  • Design, Chunk 2 board, artboards I1–I6, (i) beside When was the maintenance done?: “Each cycle counts from when that service’s lines were all closed. Untick a service to leave it as it is. Closing this accepts every date shown.”
